title: Grateful Dead Live at Legion Stadium on 1970-12-28
lineage: AUD > MR > DAT > CD > EAC > shntool > mkwACT > SHN

ai_review.summary: Warm, superb audience recording that captures a blues‑y, cowboy‑flavored 1970 show with standout Deep Elem Blues and Good Lovin' moments.
ai_review.review: The AUD source delivers an exceptionally clear and immersive soundstage – the band sits front‑and‑center while the crowd adds just enough ambience to feel the energy without overwhelming the mix. Musically the performance is a mixed bag: bluesy highlights like Deep Elem Blues, It Hurts Me Too, Smokestack Lightning and Good Lovin' shine, but some numbers (Cold Rain and Snow, Uncle John’s Band) fall flat, giving the concert an overall middle‑of‑the‑road feel despite its adventurous spirit.

ai_rating.rationale: 7 detailed reviews with a strong consensus on excellent sound quality and generally positive (though not uniformly glowing) assessments of the performance, yielding an overall rating in the high‑four range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crystal‑clear mix with the band centered; audience audible enough for atmosphere but never intrusive. Warm, forest‑in‑the‑rain ambience noted; no major dropouts or distortion.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set swings between blues‑y, cowboy‑type tunes and the classic Dead repertoire. While some sections feel middle‑of‑the‑road, the energetic highlights give the concert an adventurous, youthful vibe.
